summary: Comprehensive backend pytest suite for Qalam.ai (38 tests) — auth, documents, AI generation (questions/quiz/lesson-plan/worksheet), quizzes, classes/students, essay grading, live quiz session flow, AI assistant, reports. All 38 tests pass after fixing one real backend bug (MongoDB ObjectId not serializable in /api/generate/quiz response).

minor.issue: FIXED — was returning 500 Internal Server Error because Motor's insert_one() mutated quiz_doc in-place adding the BSON _id (ObjectId), which then failed FastAPI's jsonable_encoder ('ObjectId object is not iterable'). Fix: pop('_id', None) after insert (same pattern already used in /api/classes and /api/live/sessions).

During the initial test run, GPT-5.2 calls hit 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: ~0.006, Max budget: 0.001'. The key briefly recovered and all AI endpoints (questions/quiz/lesson-plan/worksheet/grade/assistant) pass now, but the key has a very tight per-window budget that may be exhausted by heavy usage. Main agent should monitor or request a higher budget on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (sk-emergent-33dEb908512295aAeC).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_qalam_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The suite is order-dependent (TestAIGeneration.test_generate_quiz sets the class-level quiz_id used by TestLive). The whole suite takes ~35-40s; AI calls dominate. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is exceeded, AI generation tests will return 502 — that is an env issue, not a code regression.
rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/generate/quiz returned 500 (not the wrapped 502) because the exception originated AFTER the try/except block, during JSON serialization of the response. PyMongo/Motor's `insert_one(doc)` mutates the supplied dict in-place by setting `doc['_id'] = ObjectId(...)`. The endpoint then `return quiz_doc` which still contained that ObjectId. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId, raising `ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), ...]` after the handler had already returned, hence FastAPI converts it to a generic 500. Mitigation applied: `quiz_doc.pop('_id', None)` immediately after `await db.quizzes.insert_one(quiz_doc)` (same idiom used in create_class). Verified by re-running the full suite — all 38 tests pass.
